subject: Pilot billing alignment — request for temporary invoice-only + split-contract approach
messages:
From: Jen Sawyer <jen.sawyer@aerobyte.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding: billing flexibility request

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at AeroByte is excited to move forward with the 6-week pilot. Before we kick off I'd like to confirm billing logistics. Our procurement cycle typically requires a PO for new vendors, but our legal/commercial team can sign a short pilot contract quickly if we can route a handful of invoices directly (one per week) rather than waiting for the org-wide PO to be issued (which takes 3–4 weeks).

Is Redwood able to accept pilot invoices without a formal PO temporarily if we execute a signed pilot SOW and provide weekly invoice PDFs? We can commit to a PO within 30 days after pilot acceptance, but need invoices to pay the team during the trial.

I attached a draft SOW and scope sheet (pilot-scope-AeroByte.xlsx) for context.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — we want to start next Monday.

Thanks,
Jen
Jen Sawyer
Head of Integrations, AeroByte Labs

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com

Jen — thanks for the materials and the quick timeline. We're keen to run this pilot with AeroByte. I copied Karthik (procurement) and Marissa (finance) to confirm whether we can do an invoice-only route for a short, defined pilot while you finalize the PO on your side.

High level from our side: we sometimes allow temporary invoice routing for pilots under $10k with a signed SOW and minimal evidence (W9 + contact). But there are a couple of checks:
- Risk classification for AeroByte (we need the vendor intake form filled)
- Invoice frequency and maximum cumulative exposure — we'd want weekly invoices capped at the agreed pilot budget
- Short-term internal approval (procurement sign-off + finance pre-approval)

Is the attached SOW the final version? If you can confirm invoice cadence and an internal PO commit date we can try to move quickly.

I'll let Karthik and Marissa advise on the approvals and any documentation we need.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot onboarding: billing flexibility request

Team — I reviewed Jen's ask and the SOW. Procurement is open to a constrained invoice-only path for pilots but we need to document the exception and create a short-lived "split-contract" approach so we don't bypass controls permanently. Proposed guardrails:

1) Scope & cap: weekly invoices capped at $2,500 (pilot total not to exceed $15,000).
2) Timebox: exception valid for 45 days from pilot start; PO expected within 30 days. If no PO by day 30, procurement reviews escalation list (and finance holds payments after day 45).
3) Evidence: vendor intake form, signed SOW, W9, and an authorized signatory email from AeroByte's procurement confirming PO intent and expected PO date.
4) Contract split: sign a short pilot SOW (commercial/legal) that covers scope and termination; a separate master services agreement (MSA) / PO to follow. This avoids committing to longer-term T&Cs during the invoice-only window.
5) Approval: procurement + finance + legal (Rishi) need to sign-off internally. Finance requires GL code and payment routing (Marissa to confirm).

Rishi — please confirm that legal is comfortable with the split-contract language (we should add a clause in the SOW that makes clear the invoice-only period does not modify future contract terms).

Marissa — can finance pre-authorize weekly invoice processing for this vendor under these caps? If you need a different exposure limit let me know.

Karthik

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Jen Sawyer <jen.sawyer@aerobyte.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot onboarding: billing flexibility request

Thanks — I reviewed the draft SOW and the proposed guardrails. Legal is OK with a split-contract approach provided we add a short paragraph to the SOW that:

- Limits the SOW term to the pilot period and states explicitly that any future MSA or PO will govern post-pilot commercial terms;
- Confirms that payment during the invoice-only window does not imply acceptance of future contract terms;
- Includes a simple indemnity carveout that matches our standard pilot language (I attached redlines as "aerobyte_terms_v1.pdf").

Marissa — Finance pre-approval: can you process weekly invoices up to $2,500 while procurement files an exception record? If yes, please confirm the GL code and any PO placeholder we should use when routing. If finance needs vendor banking verification before processing, call that out — we can ask AeroByte to provide bank wiring details or ACH authorization upfront.

Jen — copying you to keep AeroByte in the loop. If you can: 1) confirm that weekly invoices will be submitted every Friday; 2) fill the vendor intake form within 48 hours; and 3) confirm expected PO date (target within 30 days). Once those are done we'll finalize the internal exception and route the first invoice.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment(s): aerobyte_terms_v1.pdf
